title: Three Weeks and One Short Bag
subtitle: 交通出行 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）
meta: 主题语境：交通出行（人与自我·生活与学习·出行与交通）　|　核心词汇：route　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 route 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1993 the porter ① chose the route that no visitor in the coast would have noted, and he said the choosing was the whole of the week. The ② route, meaning the way itself and not the bag, ran three weeks and stayed unnoted in the book; a route, he said, is the only thing in a coast that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ route in that coast had the same short bag beside it, and the ④ route at the far cove, meaning the ticket they kept for the children to buy and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A route, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the porter said the noting is the part that fills three weeks.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the route was the whole of the matter, meaning the choice and not the way. The ⑥ route, meaning the choice and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; route, he said, is either something you choose or the only word that means both a way and a choice. He said the choice is the part they remember.

By 1998 the ⑦ route had become a line in a journal, and the journal had become an argument about the short bag. The ⑧ route of the whole thing, the porter wrote in August, was one coast and three weeks of noting; route, he said, is either the ticket at the far cove or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ route I remember is the way noted in the journal, which closed in 2000 and is still noted as the quietest in the coast. A ⑩ route, my mother said in 2002, is the only way that improves by being noted; every route, she said, is a choice that has agreed to look like a way. She said the choice was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 路线（指海岸里每一条旁边的那一条）
B. n. 路线（指那条路线本身，与小小的行囊相对）
C. 固定搭配：choose the route 选这一条路线
D. n. 路线（指留给孩子们买的那一张）
E. n. 路线之事（抽象总称，指一处海岸的路线之事）
F. n. 路线（指行记里写到、被记下的那一条）
G. n. 路线、取舍（指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 取舍（抽象总称，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: chose the route that no visitor in the coast would have noted
The route, meaning the way itself and not the bag
the route at the far cove
the route was the whole of the matter
the route had become a line in a journal
The route of the whole thing
A route, my mother said in 2002

answers.why: choose the route 意为“选这一条路线”，1993 年那位挑夫把海岸里没有一位游客肯记下的一条路线做了一遍。
route 意为“路线”，指那条路线本身而不是小小的行囊，它经过了三个星期而在簿子上没有被记下。
route 意为“路线”，指海岸里每一条旁边的那一条，每一条旁边都有同一只小小的行囊。
route 意为“路线”，指最远那处小湾的留给孩子们买的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
route 意为“路线、取舍”，指一件事里人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条取舍就是那件事的全部。
route 意为“取舍”，指人人都赶却无人提起的那样东西而不是那条路线，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
route 意为“路线”，指行记里写到、被记下的那一条，到 1998 年这一条成了行记里的一行。
route 意为“路线之事”，挑夫八月写道，整件事的路线之事是一处海岸和三个星期的记下。
route 意为“路线”，我记得的是行记里记下过的那一条，2000 年走到了，至今仍被说成海岸里最安静的一条。
route 为抽象总称，母亲 2002 年说，路线是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的路线。
